items.exampleEn: Our friendship started in high school.
items.exampleZh: 我們的友誼從高中就開始了。
她有兩個十幾歲的兒子。

items.exampleEn: Every grandchild got a gift from Grandma.
items.exampleZh: 每個孫子孫女都收到了奶奶送的禮物。

items.exampleEn: The train was very crowded this morning.
items.exampleZh: 今天早上火車非常擁擠。

items.exampleEn: The bride wore a white dress.
Tom is my old pal from school.
items.exampleZh: Tom 是我學生時代的老朋友。

items.exampleEn: My grandson is learning to walk.

items.sentenceEn: The bride and her father walked in together.
items.sentenceZh: 新娘和她父親一起走了進來。

items.audioEn: The market is always crowded on weekends, so let's go on Monday.
items.audioZh: 市場週末總是很擁擠，所以我們星期一去吧。
items.questionZh: 說話的人建議什麼時候去市場？

items.sentenceEn: Our friendship means a lot to me.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的友誼對我來說意義重大。

items.sentenceEn: Hey, pal! How are you doing?

items.stemEn: The bus was so ____ that I couldn't find a seat.
items.stemZh: 公車太擠了，我找不到位子坐。
我兒子的兒子是我的孫子。

items.passageEn: Grandpa Lee loves telling stories about our ancestors. They were farmers who came to Taiwan two hundred years ago. Last week, his oldest grandson got married. The restaurant was full of guests. At the wedding, Grandpa sat next to the bride and told her about his teenage years. Every grandchild laughed at his old stories.
items.passageZh: 李爺爺很喜歡講我們祖先的故事。他們是兩百年前來到台灣的農夫。上週，他的長孫結婚了，餐廳裡坐滿了客人。婚禮上，爺爺坐在新娘旁邊，跟她聊自己十幾歲時的事。每個孫子孫女聽了他的老故事都哈哈大笑。

questions.questionZh: 李爺爺喜歡講什麼故事？

items.promptZh: 我們的友誼是二十年前開始的。
referenceEn: Our friendship began twenty years ago.
Our friendship started twenty years ago.
rubricZh: 「二十年前」可寫例如 twenty years ago

items.instructionZh: 用 crowded 造一個句子，說說一個很擁擠的地方或時段。
referenceEn: The night market is crowded on Saturday nights.
The trains are very crowded in the morning.
rubricZh: crowded 表示「擁擠的」，可放在 be 動詞後或名詞前（例如 is crowded、a crowded train）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 The trains are）
